coreMemory.english: n. the set of conditions at a particular time
coreMemory.structure: deal with a situation /dil wɪð ə ˌsɪtʃuˈeɪʃən/（应对情况）；difficult situation /dɪfəkəlt ˌsɪtʃuˈeɪʃən/（困难局面）；current situation /kɝənt ˌsɪtʃuˈeɪʃən/（当前情况）；in this situation /ɪn ðɪs ˌsɪtʃuˈeɪʃən/（在这种情况下）
coreMemory.commonError: ❌ use situation with the same article in every context → ✅ check the countability of situation in context；❌ translate situation word by word → ✅ learn the complete phrase “deal with a situation”

commonErrors.right: check the countability of situation in context
commonErrors.rightPhonetic: /tʃɛk ðə countability ʌv ˌsɪtʃuˈeɪʃən ɪn kɑntɛkst/
commonErrors.note: 同一个名词在不同义项下可能有可数、不可数或单复数差异，不能机械套用冠词。

commonErrors.right: learn the complete phrase “deal with a situation”
commonErrors.rightPhonetic: /lɝn ðə kəmplit freɪz dil wɪð ə ˌsɪtʃuˈeɪʃən/
commonErrors.note: 不要只按中文逐字替换；优先把本卡高频搭配作为完整句块记忆。
